text.p: German bank Deutsche Bank AG on Monday repeated an earlier denial that it had an agreement to "pool" its 25.8 percent stake in builder Philipp Holzmann AG with a stake held by Hochtief AG.
Asked if the bank was sticking to its denial of such an arrangement in the light of renewed speculation of a deal with Hochtief, a bank spokesman said: "That remains the case."
Holzmann has a 20 percent stake in Holzmann.

The Sueddeutsche Zeitung newspaper reported at the weekend that a decision on the pooling together of shares, which would be aimed at increasing Hochtief's control over Holzmann, could be made at a Deutsche supervisory board meeting this week.
Deutsche earlier this month denied a similar report. The spokesman added that the agenda of the supervisory board meeting was secret.

The German court of appeals is due to start from April 9 hearings as to whether Hochtief should be allowed to extend its stake further. Cartel authorities earlier vetoed a plan under which Hochtief would up its stake to 35 percent.
